blocks.text: Sudden wet-to-dry changes make a stair’s remembered grip disagree with its surface.
Appearance: A wet tread slips away from its remembered stair, shedding droplets beneath the feet.
Care: Use injury supplies and the recovery time shown in Care.
Story connection: Reservoir keepers could mark the safe stair sequence before the next monsoon.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.
